program: Wingless raw-input to representation to reasoning to generation chain
question: Does replacing the R1 recency-sensitive pooled recurrent instruction head with a bounded raw-byte n-gram evidence representation restore unseen-template instruction understanding while preserving the same reasoning and raw-text generation stages?
hypothesis: On the byte-identical R1 corpus and split, fixed hashed raw 2-4 byte motif evidence with global and eight-position-bin features will reach at least 0.98 training and 0.95 held-out accuracy for operation, left operand, and right operand representations. With the unchanged 96-counter factorized reasoning learner and unchanged two-byte-context raw answer generator, held-out reasoning and exact raw output will reach at least 0.90 while exact whole-instruction lookup remains at or below 0.25.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: representation bottleneck with strong recency/position asymmetry; downstream generator covered all eight answer classes in 110 states and introduced no validity failures

repair_boundary.unchanged: R1 instruction corpus, templates, train/heldout context split, operation/value labels, target rules, reasoning factorization, reasoning training from predicted representations, canonical output bytes, output generator, whole-instruction lookup control, scientific output thresholds
repair_boundary.reason: test whether local recurrent recency is the bottleneck without changing reasoning or generation

raw_representation.windows: every contiguous raw byte window of width 2, 3, and 4; no word or token boundaries
raw_representation.global_features: 256 fixed FNV-1a hashed binary presence bins
raw_representation.position_features: eight equal byte-position bins, each with 128 fixed FNV-1a hashed binary presence bins
raw_representation.position_assignment: window start index * 8 / instruction byte length, capped at 7
raw_representation.deduplication: each hashed feature contributes at most once per instruction
raw_representation.head_training: for each class and feature, count training examples of that class containing the feature; fixed class-example counts
raw_representation.prediction_score: sum over active features of log-smoothed one-vs-rest presence odds; Laplace pseudocount 1; ties choose lowest class id

reasoning_learner: byte-for-byte same 96-counter factorized reasoning mechanism as R1; train only from R2 predicted training operation/left/right classes plus observed answer class
raw_text_generator: byte-for-byte same result-conditioned previous-two-generated-byte count generator as R1

controls.whole_instruction_lookup: byte-for-byte same exact raw instruction lookup and global fallback as R1

validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R2 calls the byte-identical R1 corpus constructor and retains all R1 templates, split rules, target rules, answers, downstream reasoning, generation, and lookup control.
Every representation feature is computed solely from raw instruction bytes; no tokenizer, word split, semantic dictionary, or evaluator byte span enters feature construction.
Feature hashes, dimensions, window widths, position bins, smoothing, and tie rules are fixed before execution.
Heldout templates and exact heldout operation/operand contexts remain absent from training.
Reasoning training consumes R2 predicted representations rather than evaluator operation/operand labels.
Reasoning inference never calls target-rule implementations.
Generation remains teacher-free and receives only the predicted result class.
Full Go regression passes before the probe and all metrics are finite.
No external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold adaptation, or post-result tuning occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and R2 materially improves representation/reasoning/output over R1 but at least one frozen 0.95 representation or 0.90 chain threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the motif-evidence representation does not materially improve the end-to-end chain over R1.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any corpus/split drift, tokenizer leakage, downstream mechanism drift, target-rule inference use, capacity, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No corpus, split, feature window, hash, dimensions, position bins, smoothing, head rule, reasoning learner, generator, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
